title: Pad under the hook
instruction: Add a pad on a new track under the chorus (bars 5-8): one held chord per bar, at least three different notes each, in key, and each chord containing the note the hook plays on that bar's downbeat. Leave the hook alone.

checks.label: Chorus bars with a held, in-key chord of 3+ notes containing the hook's downbeat note
Share of pad notes in A minor
New tracks' loudness in the chorus
